headline: Saudi Arabia Annual Consumer Inflation Rises to 1.7% in October
summary: Saudi Arabia's Consumer Price Index increased by 1.7% year-on-year in October, according to GASTAT. The uptick was driven mainly by a 3.5% increase in housing, water, electricity, and gas costs.
why: Saudi Arabia's inflation metrics track cost conditions in the Gulf region's largest economy as it executes its Vision 2030 economic diversification program.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: Moderate inflation driven by housing costs shapes domestic purchasing power and policy planning.
